decisions.title: Modular monolith architecture
decisions.context: System has multiple modules but is deployed as a single unit.
decisions.decision: Use a modular monolith with clear module boundaries.
decisions.consequences: Simpler deployment, but requires discipline to maintain boundaries.

decisions.title: Dafny for core logic
decisions.context: Need high assurance for clinical and billing logic.
decisions.decision: Implement core modules in Dafny with verified contracts.
decisions.consequences: Higher upfront cost, but fewer runtime errors.

decisions.title: FHIR R4 as interoperability standard
decisions.context: HL7 FHIR is the required data format.
decisions.decision: Use FHIR R4 for all external data exchange.

openRisks.description: FHIR mapping complexity may cause data loss.

openRisks.mitigation: Use proven registry patterns and incremental verification.
Implement immutable audit logs and regular compliance reviews.

components.name: PatientRegistry
components.internals: Uses the repository pattern to store patient entities. Validates required fields (name, DOB, contact) and enforces unique patient IDs. All operations are pure logic with I/O portals for persistence.

testCases.name: RegisterPatientCreatesRecord
testCases.description: Register a new patient with valid demographics.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns a unique patient ID and the patient record is retrievable.

testCases.name: RegisterPatientRejectsMissingName
testCases.description: Attempt to register a patient without a name.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Registration fails with a validation error.

testCases.name: UpdatePatientPreservesId
testCases.description: Update an existing patient's contact information.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The patient ID remains unchanged and the updated data is retrievable.

components.responsibility: Manages patient registration, demographics, and unique patient identifiers. Provides CRUD operations for patient records and enforces data integrity rules.

components.name: ClinicalRecords
components.internals: Uses the pipeline pattern to process clinical events through validation and transformation before storage. Lab results and prescriptions are stored as structured records linked to patient IDs.

testCases.name: AddClinicalEventStoresEvent
testCases.description: Add a new clinical event for an existing patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The event is stored and appears in the patient's medical history.

testCases.name: AddLabResultValidatesPatient
testCases.description: Add a lab result for a non-existent patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The operation fails with a patient-not-found error.

testCases.name: GetMedicalHistoryReturnsChronological
testCases.description: Retrieve medical history for a patient with multiple events.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns events sorted by date in ascending order.

components.responsibility: Tracks patient medical history, including diagnoses, procedures, medications, and lab results. Maintains a chronological record of clinical events.

components.name: Scheduling
components.internals: Uses the state-machine pattern to manage appointment lifecycle (Scheduled, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled). Validates provider availability and prevents double-booking.

testCases.name: BookAppointmentSucceeds
testCases.description: Book an appointment for an existing patient and provider at an available time.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Appointment is created with status Scheduled.

testCases.name: BookAppointmentRejectsConflict
testCases.description: Attempt to book an appointment at a time that conflicts with an existing appointment.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Booking fails with a conflict error.

testCases.name: CancelAppointmentTransitionsState
testCases.description: Cancel a scheduled appointment.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Appointment status changes to Cancelled.

components.responsibility: Manages appointment scheduling, including booking, rescheduling, cancellation, and conflict detection. Tracks appointment status transitions.

components.name: Billing
components.internals: Uses the state-machine pattern for invoice lifecycle (Unpaid, Paid, Overdue, WrittenOff). Integrates with insurance claims via the Integration module.

testCases.name: CreateInvoiceForPatient
testCases.description: Create an invoice for a patient with a set of charges.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Invoice is created with status Unpaid and total amount calculated.

testCases.name: ProcessPaymentMarksPaid
testCases.description: Process a payment for an unpaid invoice.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Invoice status changes to Paid.

testCases.name: SubmitClaimSucceeds
testCases.description: Submit an insurance claim for a valid invoice.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Claim is submitted and billing status reflects pending claim.

components.responsibility: Generates invoices, processes payments, and manages billing records. Tracks billing status and supports insurance claim submission.

components.name: Integration
components.internals: Uses the adapter pattern to wrap external FHIR APIs and the transformer pattern to convert between internal and FHIR representations. All external I/O is isolated behind portals.

testCases.name: ImportFHIRCreatesPatient
testCases.description: Import a FHIR Patient resource.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Patient is created in the registry with matching demographics.

testCases.name: ExportFHIRProducesValidResource
testCases.description: Export a patient record as FHIR.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns a valid FHIR Patient resource with correct fields.

testCases.name: SubmitClaimSendsToPayer
testCases.description: Submit an insurance claim to an external payer.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Claim is transmitted and a submission ID is returned.

components.responsibility: Handles HL7 FHIR data import/export, insurance claim submission, and external system communication. Converts internal records to/from FHIR format.

components.name: AuditTrail
components.internals: Uses the repository pattern to store audit events. Each event captures user, action, timestamp, and patient ID. Logs are immutable.

testCases.name: LogAccessCreatesEvent
testCases.description: Log an access event for a patient record.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Audit event is stored with user, action, timestamp, and patient ID.

testCases.name: QueryAuditLogFiltersByPatient
testCases.description: Query audit log for a specific patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns all events for that patient in chronological order.

testCases.name: AuditLogIsImmutable
testCases.description: Attempt to modify an existing audit event.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Modification is rejected; audit events cannot be changed.

components.responsibility: Records access audit trails for all patient data access and modifications, ensuring HIPAA compliance. Provides queryable audit logs.

components.name: FHIRConverter
components.internals: Uses the transformer pattern to map internal records to FHIR resources and vice versa. Pure logic with no I/O.

testCases.name: ToFHIRConvertsPatient
testCases.description: Convert an internal patient record to FHIR.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns a FHIR Patient resource with matching fields.

testCases.name: FromFHIRConvertsResource
testCases.description: Convert a FHIR Patient resource to internal format.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns an internal patient record with correct demographics.

testCases.name: ValidateFHIRRejectsInvalid
testCases.description: Validate a malformed FHIR resource.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns validation errors.

components.responsibility: Converts internal data models to and from HL7 FHIR resources. Handles FHIR validation and mapping.

components.name: ApiShell
components.internals: ASP.NET Core Web API. Controllers delegate to internal Dafny modules. Handles authentication and authorization.

testCases.name: HealthCheckReturnsOk
testCases.description: Call the health check endpoint.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns HTTP 200 with service status.

testCases.name: RegisterPatientEndpointWorks
testCases.description: POST to /api/patients with valid data.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns HTTP 201 with patient ID.

testCases.name: UnauthorizedAccessRejected
testCases.description: Access a protected endpoint without a token.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns HTTP 401.

components.responsibility: Exposes the system's functionality via a REST API. Handles HTTP requests, authentication, and routing to internal modules.

dataStores.name: PatientDatabase
dataStores.schema: Patients, ClinicalEvents, LabResults, Prescriptions, Appointments, Invoices, Claims, AuditLogs

auth.details: JWT bearer tokens with role-based access control

systemContext: A HIPAA-compliant patient records management system supporting patient registration, medical history tracking, appointment scheduling, prescription management, lab results processing, billing, and insurance claim submission. It ingests and emits HL7 FHIR data, maintains access audit trails, and is organized into Patient, Clinical, Billing, Scheduling, and Integration modules.

qualityAttributes.rationale: Patient data is sensitive and regulated.
Must exchange data with external systems.

deploymentTopology: Modular monolith deployed on a single application server with a relational database. The API shell is the only entry point. All modules run in-process. Database is encrypted at rest and in transit.
